description.value: Any shot you make at your Marked quarry treats its cover as one step weaker (greater becomes standard, standard becomes lesser, lesser is ignored), and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus (+3 at Undying tier) to the attack roll to overcome whatever cover remains.

cinderfall.incomplete: The flat attack-roll bonus half of this is real, buildable FlatModifier-on-target:mark: territory (P4) once unblocked; the "downgrade cover by exactly one step" half has no precedent found even in real pf2e's hunted-prey cover feats (P5's Targeting/Penetrating Shot do full cover *removal*, not a one-step downgrade) — so even post-Mark this second clause would need its own fresh precedent search. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
cinderfall.notSpell: waywarden's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell, and convert_class_spells.py declines it by design as a NON_CASTERS owner
